commons.description: A statue of a ruesi (Thai script: ฤษี), a Thai hermit and/or mystic, in his usual attire, at Wat Suan Tan. Ruesi perform certain specific rituals, practice astrology, alternative medicine, and create amulets. Their mysticism is infused with Buddhist and animist practices.
